start.text: You stand before the damp entrance of an ancient cave system.

ruby_cave.text: Glowing red crystals light up the walls as you hike down to a T-junction.

cave_diving.text: You dive into the cold underground lake and swim through to a damp T-junction.

ruby.text: looking apon the ruby cave a construct appears infront of you and its ready to charge

t_junction.text: You reach a split in the tunnel. Both paths lead toward a chest in the shadows.

mimic_encounter.text: You reach for the lock, but the chest sprouts razor-sharp teeth and roars!

real_chest.text: The chest opens smoothly! You find rare equipment that boosts your vitality and strength.
